preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Input consists of lines of text, each representing a line from stdin.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) >= 1 and all(line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Input is non-empty and all lines are non-empty after stripping whitespace.
First line is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 10) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and all(int(x) >= 1 and int(x) <= 15 for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line contains two integers N and M (1 ≤ N ≤ 15, 0 ≤ M < N*(N-1)/2).

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and all(1 <= int(x) <= N for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2] if line.strip())
preconditions.description: For each test case, the following M lines contain two integers X and Y (1 ≤ X, Y ≤ N) representing edges.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in line.split()) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip())
postconditions.description: Output consists of lines, each containing two integers x and y (space-separated) for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(x) > 0 for x in line.split()) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each test case, x and y are positive integers.
Output has exactly T lines (one for each test case).

postconditions.expression: all((lambda test_case: (lambda S: (lambda A, B: (lambda x, y: A * x == B * y and all(x >= 1 and y >= 1 for _ in range(1, x + y))))(min(S), max(S))(x, y))(S))(test_case) for test_case in test_cases)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output x and y satisfy the equation A * x = B * y, where A is the minimum value of S[i] and B is the maximum value of S[i] for all vertices i in the graph. S[i] is the maximum sum of vertices in any simple path ending at vertex i.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda test_case: (lambda S: (lambda x, y: x == min_x_y and y == min_y_x))(min_x_y, min_y_x))(test_case) for test_case in test_cases)
postconditions.description: For each test case, x and y are the smallest positive integers satisfying A * x = B * y.
